scope: static read-only Windows standard loading ledger review
verified_by_static_inspection: Reserved slot precedes scratch acquisition and any consumer call
Live record owns scratch and Arc before callback
Standard retirement reserves release-log capacity before removing ownership; Custom rejected first
Successful settlement vacates slot and drops keepalive Arc
Nested active/pending slots are not selected for reuse
No concrete lock inversion or borrow conflict found in the inspected flow

findings.finding: A new retry Error is stored but shutdown propagates only the static message. A later successful retry clears retry_error and loses that new detail without logging it. The original primary/cleanup remain logged.
findings.recommendation: Borrow and log failure/retry_error/scratch_error on failed retirement before propagating, without consuming remaining or lease.

test_recommendations: Assert Custom release refusal preserves heap bytes and the owned set before normal retirement.
limits: No Rust compiler or runtime execution in this review
Panic/OOM recovery remains outside returned-Error contract
Tutorial and provider rollback contracts are unchanged; Operation is not a universal no-owned-resource claim
A permanently unresolved cleanup deliberately retains a Shared cycle; no successful shutdown is claimed in that state

resolution.finding_resolved: Failed shutdown retries now log original failure, retry error and scratch error by reference before propagation. New checks cover the additional retry log and Custom refusal with unchanged heap/ownership/release-log.
